title: The 2023 SYSK Ho-Ho-Holiday Spectacular!
summary: Josh and Chuck's 2023 holiday special. They cover a USA Today/Civic Science regional survey of American Christmas habits, Darlene Love's "Christmas (Baby Please Come Home)" and her yearly Letterman performances, worst Christmas songs polls (Santa Baby, Wonderful Christmas Time, Mariah Carey, Justin Bieber's "Mistletoe," Simpson sisters' Little Drummer Boy), holiday cocktails (spiced gin Christmas Negroni, prosecco negroni), keeping a Christmas tree fresh, the 1974 slasher film Black Christmas, and Christmas card etiquette. Mostly casual banter with frequent tangents.
topics: Mariah Carey All I Want for Christmas Is You

entities.name: All I Want for Christmas Is You

segments.title: Opening banter
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck open the ad-free holiday special with casual chat and agree to alternate picking Christmas topics.

segments.title: Regional Christmas habits survey
segments.summary: Chuck and Josh discuss a USA Today article on a Civic Science survey of about 90,000 responses showing how Christmas practices vary by US region: work habits, parties, gift opening, travel, and dinners.

segments.title: Darlene Love and Letterman's Christmas tradition
segments.summary: The hosts discuss Darlene Love's song Christmas (Baby Please Come Home), her annual Letterman performances from 1986 to 2014, saxophonist Bruce Kapler's entrances, Paul Shaffer's and Letterman's roles, her move to The View, and the 2007 Writers Strike interruption.

segments.title: Worst Christmas songs polls
segments.summary: Chuck and Josh go through polls and lists of the most disliked holiday songs, including Santa Baby, Paul McCartney's Wonderful Christmas Time and its B-side, Mariah Carey's All I Want for Christmas Is You, and a Grand Rapids dinner theater memory.
topics: All I Want for Christmas Is You

segments.title: Justin Bieber Mistletoe and Rolling Stone's worst list
segments.summary: They criticize Justin Bieber's Mistletoe, which 53 percent of voters in a 2022 poll hated, and read from Rolling Stone's worst Christmas songs list, which panned the Simpson sisters' Little Drummer Boy cover. They then share favorite Christmas music.

segments.title: Spiced gin Christmas Negroni
segments.summary: Josh shares a holiday Negroni recipe from Olive Magazine using spiced gin (cinnamon, star anise, cloves, cardamom, bay leaves, orange peel) and a prosecco variation. Chuck and Josh also recommend local Atlanta liquor shops and a sweet potato syrup.

segments.title: Keeping a Christmas tree fresh
segments.summary: Chuck and Josh give tips from Better Homes and Gardens and tree experts: use a stand that holds plenty of water, keep it topped up, add sugar and vinegar to the water, trim an inch off the trunk bottom without shaving the sides, choose a fresh tree, keep it away from heat, use LED lights, and recycle the tree for wildlife shelter.

segments.title: Black Christmas (1974) slasher film
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck discuss Bob Clark's 1974 horror film Black Christmas, set in a sorority house over winter break, its obscene phone calls, its influence on the slasher genre, the 'call is coming from inside the house' trope, the remakes, and celebrity fans.

segments.title: Christmas card etiquette
segments.summary: Chuck introduces Merrily McKee's Etiquette School advice on Christmas cards: send by about December 15 (traditionally by January 5, the end of the twelve days of Christmas), who to include (older relatives, extended network), how to cut people from the list, and sending cards to non-Christian friends.

segments.title: Holiday sign-off
segments.summary: Josh offers holiday wishes, the hosts mention ideas from listeners Robert and Alex for next year, and they sign off.
